Record Class TileMapView.TraceSegment

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.meshtastic.client.components.map.TileMapView.TraceSegment
Record Components:
from - segment start point
to - segment end point
fromTitle - start node name
toTitle - end node name
traceTitle - target trace title
signalText - signal, direction, and hop-count label
snr - numeric SNR, or Double.NaN when unavailable
reverse - true for the reverse direction
traceIndex - selected trace index, used to spread lines apart
Enclosing class:
TileMapView

One visual trace segment between two nodes with coordinates.
